+"""Preserve pairwise geometry of a frozen reference codebook."""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Return the masked, weighted pairwise-distance preservation penalty.
+
+    ``source`` and ``target`` are accepted as part of the shared mechanism API;
+    this mechanism deliberately does not use them. ``codebook`` and
+    ``reference_codebook`` have shape [levels, codes, dimension] (or [codes,
+    dimension] for a single level).
+    """
+    reference = parameters["reference_codebook"].detach()
+    eps_geom = float(parameters.get("eps_geom", 1e-6))
+    lambda_geom = float(parameters.get("lambda_geom", 1e-4))
+    if codebook.ndim == 2:
+        codebook = codebook.unsqueeze(0)
+        reference = reference.unsqueeze(0) if reference.ndim == 2 else reference
+
+    current_delta = codebook.unsqueeze(2) - codebook.unsqueeze(1)
+    reference_delta = reference.unsqueeze(2) - reference.unsqueeze(1)
+    current_distance = torch.linalg.vector_norm(current_delta, dim=-1)
+    reference_distance = torch.linalg.vector_norm(reference_delta, dim=-1)
+    upper = torch.triu(torch.ones_like(reference_distance, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1)
+    weights = 1.0 / (reference_distance.square() + eps_geom)
+    pair_penalty = weights * (current_distance - reference_distance).square()
+    geometry = pair_penalty.masked_select(upper).sum()
+
+    valid_fraction = mask.to(device=codebook.device, dtype=codebook.dtype).mean()
+    return lambda_geom * geometry * valid_fraction
